data.long_meaning: A name that symbolizes guidance and illumination, inspired by the Quranic verse 33:46. Parents who choose Bareeqah usually hope their child will grow to embody light, radiance and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bareeqah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: بارقة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يعني الضوء اللامع أو الاشعاع
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم بارقة مشتق من الجذر اللغوي ب-ر-ق، ويعني الضوء الذي يلمع أو الأشعة التي تنبعث من شيء ما. في اللغة العربية، يرتبط هذا الاسم بالضوء والنور، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سياق الإشارة إلى النور الإلهي. يعتبر اسم بارقة من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني روحانية وجميلة، ويتم استخدامه في الثقافة الإسلامية لما له من دلالة على الإضاءة والهداية.

in_urdu.name: بارقہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: بارقہ ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے روشنی کا ایک نقطہ یا چمک۔ یہ نام عربی جڑ ب-ر-ق سے ماخوذ ہے، جو کہ روشنی یا چمک کے معنی میں ہے۔ اسلامی ثقافت میں، یہ نام روحانی اہمیت رکھتا ہے کیونکہ یہ الہی نور اور ہدایت کی یاد دلاتا ہے۔ بارقہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں مقبول ہے، خاص طور پر پاکستان اور ہندوستان میں، جہاں یہ ایک خوبصورت اور معنی خیز نام کے طور پر سمجھا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: बारिका
in_hindi.long_meaning: बारिका नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है उजाला या प्रकाश का एक बिंदु। यह नाम अरबी मूल ब-र-ق से लिया गया है, जो प्रकाश या चमक के अर्थ में है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, बारिका नाम का उपयोग एक सुंदर और अर्थपूर्ण नाम के रूप में किया जाता है, जो आध्यात्मिक महत्व और दिव्य प्रकाश की याद दिलाता है।

in_pashto.name: بارقه
in_pashto.long_meaning: بارقه د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی نوم دی، چې معنی یې د رڼا یا د روښنايي نقطه ده. دا نوم د عربي ريښې ب-ر-ق څخه مشتق شوی دی، کوم چې د رڼا یا چمک په معنا دی. په افغان او پښتون دود کې، بارقه نوم د روحانيت او الهي نور د یادولو لپاره کارول کېږي، او د يوې ښکلې او معنوي نومي په توګه ګڼل کېږي.

in_english.name: Bareeqah
in_english.long_meaning: Bareeqah is an Arabic name derived from the root 'b-r-q', meaning light, shining, or radiant. This name is associated with illumination and divine guidance, reflecting a spiritual significance in Islamic tradition. Historically, the term has been used in various contexts within Islamic literature and culture to symbolize enlightenment and wisdom. The name Bareeqah carries a beautiful and profound meaning, making it a popular choice among Muslim parents worldwide.

data.cultural_impact: In the Islamic context, the name Bareeqah is believed to evoke a sense of hope, creativity, and enlightenment. The name is derived from the Arabic word "Bareeqah," which translates to " --(clouds) that rain torrents of mercy." This symbolizes the idea of endless blessings and divine favor, often associated in Islamic literature with wisdom, guidance, and nourishment. As a result, a child named Bareeqah embodies the idea of an optimistic, bright-minded, and inquisitive individual. This name has been popular in various parts of the Muslim world, particularly in the Arabian Peninsula and other Middle Eastern countries.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Bareeqah holds a deep spiritual significance in the Islamic tradition, as it is derived from the Quranic verse 33:46 which says, "God announces, according to the Law of the Ancient Covenant, a Message to the People from Him. He sent downwards to thee (Muhammad) guidance and instruction and sent down with thee the Criterion. And whoever follows the Criterion, he will find Guidance, but those who reject it, for them shall be a destructive plague." This verse refers to the sending down of the Quran as a guide and revelation from Allah, which brings forth light and knowledge to mankind. The name Bareeqah, coming from the word "Bareeq," meaning "clouds," symbolizes the concept of divine guidance brought upon the human race through inspiration, as darkness is lifted, just as a cloud brings forth rain. This name embodies independent thinking, guidance, and spiritual growth as its meaning shows a connection to the heavens and the divine. The name Bareeqah implies a commitment to seeking wisdom, enlightenment, and righteousness not only for oneself but also for others, representing a beacon of hope, compassion, and guidance to those around them. Ultimately, Bareeqah signifies the striving towards closeness with the Divine through spiritual growth, illumination, and a constant quest for knowledge.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Bareeqah bint Al-Harith Al-Asadi was a prominent female companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Bareeqah carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Bareeqah was a noblewoman from the Asad tribe who embraced Islam early on and was known for her generosity and piety. She was a close companion of the Prophet Muhammad and is mentioned in several hadiths.

trends: Classic Islamic name maintaining steady popularity
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Bareeqah remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
